name: changelog-03
title: changelog-03
description: Featured latest release panel with CTAs and compact earlier-release list.

files.content:
"use client" import * as React from "react" import { ArrowRightIcon, DownloadIcon, PlusIcon, RefreshCwIcon, Trash2Icon, WrenchIcon, } from "lucide-react" import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge" import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button" import { Separator } from "@/components/ui/separator" import { cn } from "@/lib/utils" type ChangeType = "added" | "changed" | "fixed" | "removed" type ChangeItem = { type: ChangeType; text: string } type Release = { version: string date: string title: string description: string changes: ChangeItem[] latest?: boolean } const TYPE_META: Record< ChangeType, { label: string; className: string; icon: React.ComponentType<{ className?: string; "aria-hidden"?: boolean }> } > = { added: { label: "Added", className: "text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300", icon: PlusIcon, }, changed: { label: "Changed", className: "text-sky-700 dark:text-sky-300", icon: RefreshCwIcon, }, fixed: { label: "Fixed", className: "text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-300", icon: WrenchIcon, }, removed: { label: "Removed", className: "text-destructive", icon: Trash2Icon, }, } const RELEASES: Release[] = [ { version: "1.3.0", date: "March 20, 2026", title: "Error Pages and Blog Components", description: "New error page examples, blog UI blocks, and accessibility improvements across the board.", latest: true, changes: [ { type: "added", text: "Error 500, Error 403, and Maintenance page examples" }, { type: "added", text: "Newsletter, blog filters, comments, and changelog blocks" }, { type: "changed", text: "Error 404 moved into Error Pages category" }, { type: "fixed", text: "Decorative icons missing aria-hidden" }, { type: "fixed", text: "Category filter tabs wrap on mobile" }, ], }, { version: "1.2.0", date: "March 1, 2026", title: "Calendar and Tree Components", description: "Data-display components with keyboard navigation and ARIA support.", changes: [ { type: "added", text: "Calendar with single and range selection" }, { type: "added", text: "Tree with expand/collapse and multi-select" }, { type: "fixed", text: "Select dropdown near viewport edges" }, ], }, { version: "1.1.0", date: "February 10, 2026", title: "Data Table and Timeline", description: "Sorting, pagination, selection, and activity timelines.", changes: [ { type: "added", text: "Data table with sorting and row selection" }, { type: "removed", text: "Deprecated SimpleTable" }, ], }, { version: "1.0.0", date: "January 15, 2026", title: "Initial Release", description: "First stable release with installable components and blocks.", changes: [ { type: "added", text: "Core UI primitives and Tailwind v4 integration" }, ], }, ] export default function Changelog({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<"section">) { const latest = RELEASES.find((r) => r.latest) ?? RELEASES[0] const older = RELEASES.filter((r) => r !== latest) return (

Releases

What's new

v{latest.version} Latest {latest.date}

{latest.title}

{latest.description}

    {latest.changes.map((change, i) => { const meta = TYPE_META[change.type] const Icon = meta.icon return (
  • {meta.label}

    {change.text}

    • ) })}

Earlier releases

    {older.map((release, idx) => (
  • {idx > 0 ? : null}
    • ))}
) }
